summary.text: Nicky Muscarello is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 86 (Tangipahoa Parish), and was elected in 2018, according to the official House member page. Nicky Muscarello chairs the Civil Law and Procedure Committee.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Nicky Muscarello's occupation as Attorney/Small Business Owner.
It lists education as B.A., Southeastern Louisiana University; J.D., Southern University Law Center.
The page lists committee assignments including Civil Law and Procedure (chair), and caucus affiliations including the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and the Northshore Delegation.
